attr.title: Plants vs Zombies Portable
attr.desc: Plants vs. Zombies is a classic 2009 tower defense game by PopCap Games where you use an army of quirky, zombie-zapping plants to protect your suburban house from a horde of the undead.
attr.inst: Files Needed. Requires the user's access to the official game and copy main.pak and properties/ folder to PvZ-Portable folder
